description: This file contains utility functions for managing unsharding, registration, and state transitions of FSDP (Fully Sharded Data Parallel) parameters in PyTorch, including context managers for unsharding and re-registering parameters, and functions for handling flat parameter views.

classes.name: FlatParamHandle
classes.description: Handle for managing flattened parameters in FSDP, including methods for unpadding, unflattening, and device transfers.

methods.name: _writeback_to_local_shard
methods.description: Copies the local shard of an unsharded flattened parameter back into the sharded parameter, optionally including gradients.

methods.name: _deregister_flat_param
methods.description: Removes the flattened parameter from the module's parameters, hiding it from nn.Module methods.

methods.name: _register_flat_param
methods.description: Registers the flattened parameter to the module, making it visible to nn.Module methods.

methods.name: _unflatten_as_params
methods.description: Context manager that temporarily deregisters the flattened parameter and exposes original parameters as views, then restores them.

methods.name: _validate_unshard_params_args
methods.description: Validates arguments for unsharding parameters, raising errors or warnings for unsupported configurations.

methods.name: _unshard_fsdp_state_params
methods.description: Context manager that unshards parameters for a specific FSDP state, handling device transfers, gradient unsharding, and state updates.

methods.name: _unshard_params_for_summon
methods.description: Context manager for unsharding parameters of a module during a summon operation, with validation.

methods.name: _unshard_params
methods.description: Unshards FSDP-managed parameters for all modules in a subtree, optionally recursing.

methods.name: _deregister_orig_params
methods.description: Deregisters original parameters and registers the flattened parameter.

methods.name: _register_orig_params
methods.description: Deregisters the flattened parameter and registers the original parameters.
